messages.subject: [Mediation-information] Extension of Mediation package to lme models
messages.subject_clean: [Mediation-information] Extension of Mediation package to lme models
messages.body_plain:
Dear list members,

As I noticed that some other people (Bo and Sun) are also longing for the R code of Mediation to be extended to handle hierarchical data, I did my very best to add some lines to the R source code, in order for Mediation to work with lme models too. At least, I tried, as I am a school psychologist, and not so much a stat programming hero. Unfortunately, I don't seem to be very succesful (well, I don't blame myself, I am not an expert as many of you are) and I was wondering whether any of you has some ideas on the reasons for the following error message to appear when I use my revised package with my data:

> Model4=mediate(Model1, Model2, sims=1000, boot=FALSE, treat="graderetention", mediator="peerrelationship", conf.level=.95, dropobs=TRUE)
Error in as.data.frame.default(x) :
  cannot coerce class 'c("lmeStructInt", "lmeStruct", "modelStruct")' into a data.frame

I have added in Attachment the jEdit file and the tarball file. Lines I added are 43-44; 83; 95-99; 268-272; 278-282; 407-408; 699-700.

Bo and Sun, did you perhaps succeed in extending the R code succesfully?

Any advice would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Mieke

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Mieke Goos
Centre for Educational Effectiveness and Evaluation
Catholic University of Leuven
Dekenstraat 2
VHI 02.45
3000 Leuven
Belgium

Tel: (+32)(0)16/32.58.14
email: mieke.goos at ppw.kuleuven.be
url: http://www.steunpuntloopbanen.be/

messages.body_plain:

On Feb 12, 2012, at 11:53 PM, Peter Belmi wrote:

> Hi Dr. Imai,
> My name is Peter Belmi, and I am a doctoral student at the Organizational Behavior program at Stanford GSB. I am looking for an R package that could handle moderated mediation (Preacher & Hayes, 2008; Edwards and Lambert, 2007), and the closest that I came across to is your package, Mediation. I went through the documentation but wasn't sure if the package could handle moderated mediation. Could you tell me whether this package is suitable to test different models of moderated mediation as outlined by Preacher & Hayes? I am a novice at R so any insight would be appreciated!
> 
> Cheers,
> Peter Belmi

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Yes, moderated mediation will be implemented in the next update along 
with other extensions. In fact that particular function has been already 
coded up in our development version, so if you need it right away we can 
send the source code to you (usual disclaimer would apply, of course).

Best,
Teppei
